hypotheses.expect: Under a test run, store.query reads a table from cairn_testing only when THIS run created it (its test id is in the table's cairn_owned.test_ids); any other run reads that table live and read-only. This makes outline 4.3.1.5.1.5.2 clause (5) true at the table grain (testing artifacts invisible to all but the run that made them) and e4fd7f28faaf's 'a table the run itself created'. Clause (6), each run's rows dropped at run end with the sleep cycle sweeping orphans, is not built here: this ticket neither drops nor forbids dropping.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) under test id A, a table created through create_owned_table is read by store.query from cairn_testing (its rows, not live's); (2) under test id B, the table A created is read LIVE: the count equals the count read with no test id, and an INSERT sent down that read path raises a read-only error; (3) a cairn_testing table whose cairn_owned row carries an empty test_ids routes no run to testing: under any test id it reads live; (4) after B also creates the table, both A and B read it from cairn_testing, and a third id C reads it live
hypotheses.piece: _ensure_registry, under a test run, adds cairn_owned.test_ids text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' (idempotent). create_owned_table, under a test run, appends the run's
